changes.reason: HTML to PDF and image rendering use browser paragraph defaults: one em above and below each p element, including Document mode. Adjacent block margins still collapse into one gap. Word-to-HTML output keeps paragraphs inside list items at zero margin, so exported Word lists retain their compact spacing. A bottom margin at the end of a page is dropped rather than opening an empty page when the content fits. HTML that relied on no paragraph top margin gains space above paragraphs; set p { margin-top: 0 } to keep the previous layout.

changes.new: OfficeHtmlDocumentOptions.DocumentTheme accepts an OfficeTheme; when set, it overrides the preset palette and font choices
changes.reason: Use the same immutable document theme for semantic HTML and Office files. The shared HTML shell projects its palette, font stack, table-header text and light or dark color scheme. Existing enum presets remain available when DocumentTheme is omitted. New-OfficePowerPointHtmlOptions defaults its shared document theme to Modern.

Batch image export can select noncontiguous one-based retained surfaces in caller order, including repeats, through the canonical PDF page selector and selected-count limits. The request page set, HTML layout, PDF output, archives and single-image operations retain their existing selection contracts.

changes.old: HtmlRenderEngine.Execute/ExecuteAsync with a Png, Jpeg, Tiff, Webp or Svg encoder and plain HtmlRenderOptions
changes.new: Pass HtmlPdfExportOptions in the request; HtmlPdfExportOptions.ForImageExport(options) keeps the shared options resource policy. document.RenderImages(request) in OfficeIMO.Html.Pdf encodes a request directly.
changes.reason: Image encoders measure and paint text through the PDF engine, which OfficeIMO.Html no longer carries. Plain options now throw ArgumentException for these encoders; RenderImages keeps the shared options resource policy.

changes.old: HtmlConversionDocument.ToPng / ToJpeg / ToTiff / ToWebp / ToSvg(HtmlRenderOptions options = null, int pageIndex = 0)
changes.new: HtmlConversionDocument.ToPng / ToJpeg / ToTiff / ToWebp / ToSvg(HtmlRenderOptions options = null, int pageIndex = 0, CancellationToken cancellationToken = default) (package OfficeIMO.Html.Pdf)
changes.reason: Cancellable operations take a final CancellationToken cancellationToken = default, in synchronous and asynchronous forms alike.

changes.old: HtmlConversionDocument.SaveAsPng / SaveAsJpeg / SaveAsTiff / SaveAsWebp / SaveAsSvg(path | stream, HtmlRenderOptions options = null, int pageIndex = 0)
changes.new: ... same, plus CancellationToken cancellationToken = default (package OfficeIMO.Html.Pdf)
changes.reason: Cancellable operations take a final CancellationToken.
